about: Test values of the day analysis (decision 76, docs/ARCHITECTURE.md m-8, condition 4). Each case: a raw log (tools/fixtures/dayrec-logs/<case>.jsonl), an optional network_patch to merge into lifts of site/data/runs-and-lifts.json (by lift id) before the analysis, and the expected final and live results of tools/dayrec (the reference). An app passes a case when tools/dayrec/compare.py rules hold: see tools/dayrec/README.md, "Running the test values in an app". The truth is what the synthetic skier did; it is for people, the comparison is with expected.

cases.name: lift_basic
cases.about: A long queue, then the Goodaura gondola from the bottom to the top station.

cases.name: lift_stopped
cases.about: The Soliko chair lift, 40 % faster than the data, stopped for two minutes half way: one ride.

cases.name: lift_mid_station
cases.about: Goodaura gondola, off at a middle station that exists only in this test (network_patch), then Goodaura 1.

cases.name: lift_unmapped_stop
cases.about: The same ride and descent, without the test station: the stop is not a mapped station.

cases.name: run_single
cases.about: One descent on one run: Goodaura 1.

cases.name: run_single_nobaro
cases.about: The same, without a barometer (iPhone without the motion permission, simulator).

cases.name: run_to_run
cases.about: From run to run: Kudebi 2 (two lines) into Soliko 1.

cases.name: shared_tatra
cases.about: Tatra 1 to the fork, then Tatra 2; the lower stretch is shared with Tatra 1 and is shown as both.

cases.name: offpiste
cases.about: Goodaura 1, with 160 m off the runs and back: an off-piste descent.

cases.name: offpiste_short
cases.about: A short trip 70 m to the side of Goodaura 1 and back: not an off-piste descent.

cases.name: falls
cases.about: Here you fell: one real fall among a jump, the phone falling in the pocket, a bump, a hard stop and a bump on the gondola.

cases.name: fall_dismissed
cases.about: A fall the skier dismissed ("I did not fall"): only the summary line is left, and it never counts.

cases.name: run_from_middle
cases.about: Measure one run (mode run), started half way down Goodaura 1: stops at the bottom station.

cases.name: run_short_stop
cases.about: Measure one run (mode run): a 45 s rest on Tatra 1 does not stop it; boarding the Shino lift does.

cases.name: run_still
cases.about: Measure one run (mode run): two minutes standing in the middle of Goodaura 1 stop it.

cases.name: fall_dismissed_closed
cases.about: The same day after it was closed: the dismissed window was deleted from the file, the dismissal line stays.

cases.name: queue_and_hut
cases.about: A 7 minute queue, a 25 minute break at the top, and a rest in the middle of the run.

cases.name: gps_spike
cases.about: One reading of 100 km/h with a jump of the position, in the middle of the descent.

cases.name: signal_loss
cases.about: No readings for a minute in the middle of the descent.

cases.name: crash_resume
cases.about: The app was killed: the last line is cut in half, 90 seconds are missing, then a resume event.

cases.name: full_day
cases.about: A full day: 13 rides on 8 lifts (one slow, one stopped), Tatra 2 with the shared stretch, off-piste, Kobi, lunch, a minute without signal, and falls, jumps and bumps on the way.
